units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:4:2">Cant. R. to III, 4</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 47:2">Is. XLVII, 2</cite>) <he>פרשי צְנִיעוּתֵךְ וכ׳</he> uncover thy secret, that means the (Babylonian) king that is kept behind seven enclosures.
Num. R. s. 1 יפה היא הצ׳ the privacy (in the Tabernacle) is becoming; a. e.— discretion, chastity, decency, piety.
<cite ref="Megillah 13b:1">Meg. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>בשכר צ׳ … ברחל וכ׳</he> as a reward for Rachel’s discretion Saul was her descendant.

<cite ref="Megillah 13b:6">Ib.</cite> <he>ומה צ׳ היתה וכ׳</he> and wherein consisted Rachel’s discretion? <cite ref="Eruvin 100b:29">Erub. 100ᵇ</cite> <he>אילמלא … צ׳ מחתול</he> if the Law had not been given to us, we might have learned decency from the cat; a. e.
